_doc: 48x48 portraits of the 24 named heroes (FACTION_HUMANS, FACTION_UNDEAD and FACTION_GOBLINS section 8; NAMED_HEROES in src/data/classes.ts). Same endpoint, layers and options as the class portraits of class-heroes (bzc.14): each hero keeps the class costume and colours of its class portrait and differs as a person (face, hair, age, one accessory from the name or specialty). No faction layer (the 2000-character cap); colours in each subject. Faces south-east, never mirrored. Recipes are never edited after generation: add a new id (new seed) instead. Candy Kingdom (bead border_marches-bzc.113, docs/design/FACTION_CANDY.md section 8): the eight Candy heroes keep the Nutcracker or Confectioner costume of their class portrait (tall black shako, candy-cane red coat with white frogging and a painted wooden face; or white frilly mob cap, strawberry pink dress and white apron) and differ as persons. Ids are the distinctive first word of each name, as for the other factions: kernel, brittle, walnut, humbug, praline, treacle, fondant, gingersnap.
